profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a Tokyo, Japan-based public company founded in 1981. According to its official website, the company presents itself as led by representative director, chairman and president executive officer Masayoshi Son. The site describes the company's offerings through its philosophy, vision, and strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations materials, business segments and group enterprises, and sustainability information.

The company frames itself as positioned in the era of the AI revolution, with its website introducing the company's thoughts on AI and the initiatives of group enterprises regarding the possibilities that AI brings. The held facts record SoftBank Group as a for-profit public company with ticker SFTBF and CIK 0001065521, verified as of September 12, 2026.
